title: Apple says that Trump's looming tariffs on China would increase prices on Apple Watch and AirPods (AAPL)
text:
Tim Cook Donald Trump
Friday, 7 September 2018 ( 17 hours ago )
· *Apple opposes tariffs proposed by the Trump administration on $200 billion worth of Chinese goods.*
· *The tariffs are currently in a period of public comment.*
